# Claims Assessment Memo

**Insured:** Dovecote Learning Ltd | **Policy:** CC-1629

## 1. Summary

Dovecote Learning Ltd reported the theft of a soldering station and an oscilloscope from a locked office at a rented studio on Pike Street. The claim is under commercial contents policy CC-1629. The theft was reported to the police and is supported by two invoices. The claim is covered under clause 4.2, and no exclusion applies on the file as it stands. The reserve is 5,876 dollars. The date of the theft should be confirmed before payment (see section 3).

## 2. Facts

- The insured reported the loss on 16 April 2026. [notice of loss]
- The loss was theft overnight from a locked office of a soldering station and an oscilloscope. [notice of loss]
- The location was a rented studio on Pike Street. [notice of loss]
- The theft was reported to the police on 18 April 2026 under reference CR/2026/4221. [police report]
- The police report was made by Dovecote Learning Ltd and lists the same two items. [police report]
- The items were in a locked container at the time of the theft. [police report]
- The soldering station is invoiced by Beacon Office Supply at 4,829 dollars. [invoice 1]
- The oscilloscope is invoiced by Crane & Sons Electronics at 1,047 dollars. [invoice 2]
- The file does not state the date of the theft itself. [notice of loss] [police report]
- The policy schedule is not in the file. Only the policy extract is. [policy]

## 3. Coverage analysis

**Insuring clause.** Clause 4.2 covers loss of business contents caused by theft at the premises named in the schedule, "and at any other premises while in the insured's custody". The loss is theft of business equipment from the Pike Street studio. [notice of loss] [police report] The schedule is not in the file, so I cannot confirm whether the studio is a named premises. The insured reported the theft from its own locked office there, so the claim falls within the "other premises while in the insured's custody" limb of 4.2. [notice of loss] [policy cl. 4.2]

**Other cover clauses.** Clause 4.5 (transit), 4.7 (escape of water) and 4.9 (electrical surge) are not engaged. The loss is theft, not carriage by an employee, water damage or a surge. [notice of loss] [policy cl. 4.5, 4.7, 4.9]

**Exclusions.**
- **7.1 Unattended property.** This excludes theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless it was in a locked container or locked room. The items were taken from a locked office and were in a locked container. [notice of loss] [police report] Even if the space were shared, the exception in 7.1 would apply, so the exclusion does not bar the claim. [policy cl. 7.1]
- **7.3 Wear and tear.** This excludes gradual deterioration. The loss is theft and no deterioration is alleged. [notice of loss] [policy cl. 7.3] It does not apply.
- **7.5 Unproven loss.** This excludes theft not reported to the police within seven days. The police report is dated 18 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss on 16 April 2026. [police report] [notice of loss] [policy cl. 7.5] The file does not give the date of the theft, so the seven-day window cannot be measured from it. The date of the theft should be confirmed with the insured and recorded. On the dates in the file, the exclusion is not engaged.

## 4. Decision

**Covered** under clause 4.2 (Contents, theft). Exclusions 7.1, 7.3 and 7.5 do not apply on the file as it stands. Confirm the date of the theft (clause 7.5) and the premises position in the schedule before payment.

## 5. Reserve

Under clause 9.1 the reserve is the sum of the invoices, less the 250 dollar excess where the schedule applies one. No schedule is in the file, so no excess is shown and none is applied. [policy cl. 9.1]

| Item | Source | Amount (dollars) |
|---|---|---|
| Soldering station | [invoice 1] | 4,829 |
| Oscilloscope | [invoice 2] | 1,047 |
| Excess | [policy cl. 9.1] | none shown |
| **Reserve** | | **5,876** |

If the schedule, once obtained, shows an excess, the reserve reduces by that amount. Under clause 9.1 the 250 dollar excess would give a reserve of 5,626 dollars.
